newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian baby born in detention is named Justice.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian baby born in detention is named Justice.

text.p: An Egyptian woman detained on suspicion of hawking marujuana gave birth to a baby boy and named him el-Adl (Justice), security sources said.
They said Camillia Mohamed Saber, 20, was arrested for hawking marijuana and tissue paper packets at a traffic light in the Cairo suburb of Giza.
She told the officers questioning her she was having contractions and gave birth to the baby before they could take her to a hospital or bring in a doctor.
The sources said Saber told prosecutors she had named her baby Justice because she was innocent of the drug trafficking charges.
